description: People: one entry per person assembled from every app that serves their OpenProfile.md (podcasters from p0dcasters, public profiles from OutreachGraph). Search by name, headline or anything in the document; newest change first. Each answer carries the page, the openprofile.md URL, accounts, topics, Broadcast shows, the Guest section, and the job title, company and seniority the person published (filter on them with title, company, seniority or tags).

q.description: Text to match against the name, headline and document (optional)

since.description: ISO time: only profiles changed after it (optional)

tags.description: Facet tags every result must carry: title:…, company:…, seniority:…

title.description: Job title, matched as its tag (`CTO` is title:cto) (optional)

name: search_profiles
